sn1.21:1.1: Sāvatthi nidānam || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi || ||
sn1.21:2.1: Sattiyā viya omaṭṭho || ḍayhamāne va matthake || kāmarāgappahānāya || sato bhikkhu paribbaje ti || ||
sn1.21:3.1: Sattiyā viya omaṭṭho || ḍayhamāne va matthake || sakkāyadiṭṭhippahānāya || sato bhikkhu paribbaje ti || ||
